description: NSW Speed Zones is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by TfNSW Open Data Hub and Developer Portal. Speed zones are set to enable drivers travelling at a speed limit to safely respond to potential risks in the road environment. This data set contains data for NSW speed zones that are categorised as: Ordinary Permanent, Shared, High Pedestrian, School, Variable, Local Traffic, Truck & Bus, Wet Weather, School Bus, Toll Plaza and Default. Coverage is New South Wales; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-08-01. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
